function.name: send_whatsapp_brochure
function.description: Sends the ElevateBox product brochure and eCommerce pricing catalog to the user via WhatsApp when they express high interest.

phone_number.description: The user's 10-digit WhatsApp phone number with country code.

business_category.description: The customer's business category (e.g., retail, apparel, electronics).

function.name: schedule_callback
function.description: Schedules a dedicated follow-up voice call with an ElevateBox sales executive for warm leads.

preferred_time.description: The preferred time slot requested by the user.

preferred_date.description: The preferred date for the callback.

contact_number.description: Phone number to reach back on.
